decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is central to the firm's strategy of binding mobile communication and trusted second-channel security, and its software-based upkeep costs little, so keeping it open preserves upside in a growing market.

The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture was upgraded to its own page in 2019 and underpins the integrated ecosystem the firm is heading toward, which signals a further commitment rather than abandonment.

The QR hardware token gained its own page and still serves regulated transaction authorization, but hardware carries higher holding costs and is pressured by app-based authentication, so it remains an option worth watching rather than one to drop yet.

The payment network compliance suite was only mentioned and never featured, which leaves its value unproven, but demanding payment security regulation keeps it relevant and maintaining it is cheap, so keeping the option open is reasonable for now.
